Tom — following our partner kickoff last week, we discovered a calendar conflict that will leave the joint demo unstaffed for ~20 minutes in the middle of the runthrough (SI lead has an unavoidable exec overlap). We need to pin a mitigation plan so we don't lose momentum with the Stratus execs.

Quick ask: can you confirm if the Stratus panel can shift +30 minutes earlier or if we should compress the agenda to keep the current time slot? Options I think are viable: 
- Move everything 30m earlier (requires SI ops to free up)
- Keep time, compress technical deep-dive by 20m and add a follow-up breakout for SI deep content
- Swap facilitator roles for the 20m gap (Redwood host covers Q&A and high level while SI records deep notes)

I cc'd Vanessa and Kim to weigh in on logistics and runbook updates. I attached an updated mutual action plan and a snapshot of current availability.

Thanks for the heads up, Priyom. Apologies — our SI lead (Ravi) just pinged; he has an exec town hall that bumped into the slot. We can either shift the whole demo earlier by 30m only if Stratus execs confirm availability (I'll ask now), or we can keep the existing time and have your suggestion of Redwood covering the 20m Q&A — that seems safer on our end.

Two notes: 
1) If we compress, Ravi wants to ensure we still cover the integration TLDR and the reference architecture slides — he can prerecord a 6–8 minute segment if needed.
2) We definitely want the breakout to happen same week (preferably within 48 hours) so prospects get the SI technical follow-through.

I'll confirm exec availability within the hour and loop Maya.

—Tom
